description: Find real SaaS marketing websites to use as design references. Filter by category, page section (e.g. sites with a captured pricing page), visual style, tech stack, font or brand colour, and/or a free-text query (product name or industry). Returns each site's website URL, category, style, stack, colour palette, fonts, captured sections, and a link to its screenshots.

category.description: Product category, e.g. "AI", "Engineering & Infrastructure". See list_filters.

color.description: Hex colour; matches sites with a close colour in their palette, e.g. "#5e6ad2".

font.description: Font family used on the site, e.g. "Inter".

section.description: Only sites with this section captured, e.g. "pricing", "heroes", "faq", "footers".

stack.description: Tech stack of the marketing site, e.g. "Next.js", "Webflow", "Framer".

name: search_sites
title: Find SaaS websites
